chapter: Big Eye Louis and Barnes's own playing
title: Barnes's plans to play again with a small band, with Pudge
summary: The interviewers encourage Barnes to play again; he plans to get in touch with Pudge about a four- or five-piece band.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
